## No-Load Rules

- Do not load donor routing when target evidence is already sufficient.
- Do not load design or UX overlays for non-visual structural work.
- Do not load review gates for low-risk internal forensics.
- Do not load ready-pack before a real artifact set exists.
- Do not load `link-workspace-packages` unless the task is specifically about workspace linking or package resolution failure.

## Output Depth
